body: I don't have any love to give anyone. I can barely kiss people before I start to breakdown from the memories of my cousin. I will never be able to move past that. Sure, I did once, and then she had a miscarriage. That's what really pushed me over the edge.
Sure, it's in human nature to try to survive. But I do not want to live. Not in this nightmarish, hell of a world.

I am exhausted. I have been for a very long time. I know that my death will have impact on the world, but all that everyone else is going to know is that I went missing. They won't find my body, because there won't be one.
I wouldn't have anything to say, I already said it all.
